purpose: Expose scalar, source-authoritative reasons for each detected upstream stationary-stop epoch without changing factor admission or numerical settings.

diagnostic_contract.detected_epoch_conservation: detected = missing_velocity_key + graph_velocity_nonfinite + speed_nonfinite + speed_gate_accepted + speed_gate_rejected
diagnostic_contract.seed_precedence: finite exact same-run stop seed; otherwise existing graph velocity fallback
diagnostic_contract.min_max_policy: finite evaluated speeds only; summary emits null when none

tests.build: cmake --build build --target gnss_run_tests -j2; cmake --build build --target gnss_fgo_imu_no_base -j2
tests.focused_gtest_result: 7/7 passed; includes missing/nonfinite seed fallback and exact threshold cases

limitations: A normal IMU graph materializes every velocity key, so the missing-key bucket is fail-closed telemetry and remains zero in the valid synthetic handoff; it is not fabricated by removing a graph state.
